description: The assisted fraction among non-putback two-point points is at least the overall assisted two-point fraction.
explanation: Putback two-point points are included among unassisted two-point points; removing this unassisted subset cannot lower the assisted share of the remaining two-point points.

description: The sum of the non-heave and overall three-point percentages is nonnegative.
explanation: Both columns are percentages on a 0-to-1 scale, so each is nonnegative; consequently their sum is universally nonnegative, without assuming that removing heaves must raise the percentage.

description: Overall and non-heave three-point percentages have a sum at most two.
explanation: Both three-point percentage columns are stated to lie on a 0-to-1 scale, so their sum cannot exceed 2.

description: The overall and non-putback assisted two-point fractions have a nonnegative sum.
explanation: Both columns are fractions on a 0-to-1 scale and therefore nonnegative.

description: The overall and non-putback assisted two-point fractions have a sum at most two.
explanation: Each assisted two-point fraction is bounded above by 1, so their sum is at most 2.

description: The assisted three-point fraction and three-point attempt share have a nonnegative sum.
explanation: Both columns are defined as nonnegative fractions on a 0-to-1 scale.

description: The assisted three-point fraction and three-point attempt share have a sum at most two.
explanation: Each of these two fractions is bounded above by 1, giving a combined upper bound of 2.

description: Shot-quality average and three-point attempt share have a nonnegative sum.
explanation: ShotQualityAvg and FG3APct are both stated or defined as fractions between zero and one.

description: Shot-quality average and three-point attempt share have a sum at most two.
explanation: Both quantities are bounded above by 1, so their sum cannot exceed 2.

description: Effective and true shooting percentages have a nonnegative combined value.
explanation: These are efficiency percentages for scoring and are nonnegative for nonnegative makes and points.

description: Total points and usage have a nonnegative combined value.
explanation: Points is a scoring rate and Usage is a percentage of possessions, so both are nonnegative quantities.
